description: claude-cli: modal visible (This command requires approval) → detectStatus returns waiting_approval; modal dispatch order wins over prior spinner cue

anchors.name: modal visible
anchors.notes: The 'This command requires approval' line triggers the modal question pattern. detectStatus returns waiting_approval because the modal group is checked first in the dispatch order (['modal', 'spinner', 'settled-prompt']), so even though the braille spinner and 'esc to interrupt' are in the accumulated buffer, the modal wins. Note: the claude-cli declarative buttonPattern uses capture group 1 for the optional ❯/›/> prefix, so parseApproval is intentionally not checked here — it is handled by the daemon's outer approval system.
